findings.evidenceJa: 貴方たちを運んだのは私です
findings.governingReading: Rider confirms that she transported Shirou and the others.
findings.explanation: The English confirms her agency but omits the transported group.

findings.highlight: If you have a question, please ask it.
findings.evidenceJa: 訊ね事があるのなら先にどうぞ
findings.governingReading: Rider invites Shirou to ask his question first, before her own.
findings.explanation: The English omits the turn-order concession.

findings.highlight: using her life to stay in this world
findings.evidenceJa: その肉体を再契約までの糧として
findings.governingReading: In Shirou’s feared scenario, Rider would use Sakura’s body as sustenance until another contract.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes the concrete body and its role as nourishment into “life.”

findings.evidenceJa: その魂の在り方が近いから
findings.governingReading: Rider says Saber and Shirou were drawn together because the form or nature of their souls is close.
findings.explanation: The English retains similarity while deleting its soul-level basis.

findings.highlight: since she was adopted to the Makiri family
findings.evidenceJa: マキリの家に貰われてから
findings.governingReading: Rider asks about the suffering Sakura endured since being taken or adopted into the Makiri household.

findings.highlight: I don’t think I can say anything about it, nor should I mention it
findings.evidenceJa: それを口にする事も、しちゃいけない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says he must not put a claim of understanding into words.
findings.explanation: The English makes him refuse to discuss or mention the abuse at all.

findings.governingReading: Rider shares Sakura’s sensations through their Master-Servant connection.
findings.explanation: The English changes shared sensation into emotional agreement or empathy.

findings.governingReading: Rider confronts him from behind her single blindfold.
findings.explanation: The English makes the blindfold plural.

findings.governingReading: Shirou grips his immobile left arm.
findings.explanation: The English again weakens inability to move into stiffness.

findings.highlight: If I can fight with one arm, I should.
findings.evidenceJa: どんな身体だろうとまだ戦えるのなら、戦わないといけない
findings.governingReading: Whatever state his body is in, he believes he must fight if he can still fight.
findings.explanation: The English adds a separate one-arm proposition before translating the source thought.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺は俯いたまま答えがない
findings.governingReading: Shirou remains with his head lowered and cannot answer.
findings.explanation: The English deletes his sustained physical posture.

findings.highlight: You should be prepared when that time comes
findings.evidenceJa: その時までに覚悟を決めておく
findings.governingReading: Rider tells him to settle his resolve by the time the answer arrives.
findings.explanation: The English shifts the deadline from before that moment to when it occurs.

findings.highlight: it can make any wish come true
findings.evidenceJa: 他のどんな望みも叶う
findings.governingReading: The Grail could grant any other wish, in contrast with the single wish of Sakura’s happiness.
findings.explanation: The English deletes “other,” weakening the exception structure.
